title: Lemon-Tahini Tofu & Broccoli Tray Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 450°F with racks in the upper and lower thirds.
Wrap the tofu in a clean towel and set a heavy pan on top to press it while you cut the potatoes.
Cut the potatoes into 1-inch chunks. Toss them on a baking sheet with 1 tbsp of the oil, ½ tsp of the oregano, and salt. Roast on the upper rack for 10 minutes.

Tear the pressed tofu into rough 1-inch pieces; ragged edges crisp better than clean cubes. Toss in a bowl with 1 tbsp of the oil, the starch, the remaining ½ tsp oregano, and plenty of salt and pepper, until no dry starch shows.
Take out the potatoes, flip them, and push them to one side of the sheet. Spread the tofu in a single layer on the other side and return the sheet to the upper rack for 10 minutes.
Cut the broccoli into florets, then peel the stems and slice them into coins. Toss on a second baking sheet with the remaining 1½ tbsp oil and salt, and roast on the lower rack.
Make the dressing: whisk the lemon zest and juice, 2 cloves grated garlic, 1 tbsp oil, and a pinch of salt in a small bowl.
Make the drizzle: whisk the tahini, lemon juice, 1 clove grated garlic, and a pinch of salt. It will seize up; keep whisking in cold water a spoonful at a time until it pours.

After 10 minutes, flip the tofu and broccoli and swap the two sheets between racks. Roast 10–12 minutes more, until the tofu is deep golden and crisp, the broccoli is charred at the edges, and the potatoes are browned.
Tip everything onto one sheet, pour the dressing over while it's hot, and toss.
Plate, drizzle with the tahini, and finish with the parsley and pumpkin seeds.
notes: Dress the tray while it's hot so the potatoes and tofu soak up the lemon and garlic. Swapping the sheets halfway keeps the lower one from steaming. Chopped toasted almonds work in place of the pumpkin seeds. Protein per serving: tofu ~18g, broccoli ~6g, tahini ~4g, potatoes ~4g, pumpkin seeds ~2g, about 34g.
freezeNote: The crisp tofu and roasted vegetables go soft once frozen. Make what gets eaten.
